page.content:
Aerial assassin who crossed the Forbidden Door into AEW stardom.

How Will Ospreay connects

  • Event: Forbidden Door — Ospreay crossed into AEW through the Forbidden Door.
  • Topic: AEW — Will Ospreay became an AEW main-event figure after NJPW.

What is Will Ospreay?

Will Ospreay came through New Japan and the Forbidden Door, then became an AEW International and later world-title figure known for the Hidden Blade and Stormbreaker.

Key threads lead to Forbidden Door and AEW.
